scripts.profile:cprofile: uv run python -m cProfile -o cprofile_output.prof -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 1
scripts.profile:memory: uv run mprof run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 1
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check . && uv run mypy app
